nodes.decision: T8 Profile scope: no "Edit" button or Members' Circle card (Edit profile is "Later", Circle terms [OPEN]); child cards show name · age only (no per-child discipline/level data in the schema); "Book a session for Ali" opens Explore until T14; instructor-set levels read "Intermediate · your instructor, 6 Oct" (no instructor id on interests). New provisional tokens: profile photo 64 (§7.14), icon 28, dashed card border 1.5 / min height 64
nodes.rationale: Fit Phase 1 without a schema change or invented copy

nodes.label: D36: T10 Home
nodes.decision: T10 Home: (1) the Hobbies group rail is titled "Upcoming workshops" (the canvas Instructor artboard's title) and shows the 6 soonest, instead of "Workshops this weekend", which would be wrong on weekdays and depends on whether the weekend is Fri–Sat or Sat–Sun; (2) empty next-booking copy for Hobbies ("Nothing booked yet · Find a workshop to try this week") and Sports ("No sessions booked yet · Find a coach near you") is Claude's draft (handoff gives only Education's; Languages from the canvas); (3) distance on Home is from the learner's area centre until device location is wired in Explore (T11); (4) until T12/T13/T17 exist, instructor cards, workshop cards and "Book again" open Explore and the next-booking card opens Bookings (shortcut: comment); (5) approved Arabic added for Home: evening greeting, Sports search placeholder, "Open today near you", "Next session · in 2 days"
nodes.rationale: Handoff §7.4 leaves these open

nodes.label: D37: T11 Explore
nodes.decision: T11 Explore: (1) "This week" = the next 7 Cairo days; "Weekend" = Fri–Sat within them (§7.5); (2) availability filters on the soonest slot of any session type, not of the selected type (shortcut:, revisit with the Phase 2 map); (3) distance, on Explore and now also Home, is from the device when location was already allowed, otherwise the learner's area centre, and Explore never prompts for location (supersedes D36 item 3); (4) workshops take instructor gender from the instructor cards, since group_sessions has no gender column (no view change); (5) the result line adds "within N km" only when a distance filter is set; (6) Explore holds the search, chips, tab, sort and filters in memory, so they survive switching tabs but not a relaunch; (7) instructor and workshop cards do nothing until T12/T13
nodes.rationale: Handoff §7.5 leaves these open; no schema change

nodes.label: D39: T13 Workshop
nodes.decision: T13 Workshop: (1) route workshop/[offering id]?slot=, for workshop offerings only; revision and conversation groups (type group) go through Book (T14), since book() allows 1–3 seats for workshops and exactly 1 for every other type; (2) the next three dates are shown, full ones kept but disabled ("Full"), and the first date with seats left is preselected (or the one asked for); (3) the stepper is one adjustable control for VoiceOver plus two labelled buttons, capped at min(3, seats left), and the count pulls down when a smaller date is picked; (4) Reserve stays disabled until Review & pay (T15); (5) the seat rules live in data/rules.ts, the app-side mirror of the SQL rules (design.md §1)
nodes.rationale: Handoff §7.7 leaves these open

nodes.label: D40: T14 Book
nodes.decision: T14 Book: (1) route book/[offeringId]?slot=; the session-type segment switches between the instructor's sibling offerings in that discipline (workshops excluded); revision and conversation groups on Home now open Book; (2) "this week / next week" = 7 Cairo days from today, then the 7 after; the screen opens on the requested slot's day, else the first day with open times; (3) a slot is offered only if isBookable (mirror of SQL assert_bookable: future, and ≥ 60 minutes ahead when later today) and has a seat; others show as booked; (4) the one-line type descriptions ("Just you and Nour, 60 min", "Up to 4 people, … price per person", "Ages 6–14, 45 min. A guardian stays on site.") are Claude's draft; (5) kids: the child card shows the first family member in the offering's age range, "Change" cycles when there are several (else opens Family & kids), and with none it offers "Add a child…"; (6) the instructor profile's Book opens the cheapest lesson type, a "Next available" chip opens its own offering at that time; (7) Continue stores the choice in a draft and stays disabled until Review & pay (T15)
nodes.rationale: Handoff §7.8 leaves these open

nodes.label: D32: T9 onboarding
nodes.decision: T9 onboarding: (1) the four level descriptions are Claude's draft ("New to it, or tried it a few times" / "Know the basics and want to get better" / "Practise often and have solid technique" / "Compete, perform or teach"): the handoff asks for them but gives no text; (2) one question form for every pick, "How experienced are you with pottery?" (the handoff's "How do you play padel?" reads wrong for swimming or SAT); (3) discipline icons are SF Symbols / Material picked to match the canvas drawings; (4) "Use my location" stores only the nearest area, not the position; (5) choosing My child or Both opens Family & kids after Home ("add kids as family members next"); (6) the journey gate keeps onboarding open to onboarded learners (listed after the tabs) so Profile's "Change interests and levels" reopens steps 1–2; (7) picks and levels save when Levels finishes, profile answers when step 3 finishes
nodes.rationale: Handoff §7.3 leaves these open

nodes.label: D38: T12 Instructor profile
nodes.decision: T12 Instructor profile: (1) route instructor/[id]?discipline= (an instructor can teach several disciplines; the profile shows one); (2) "Next available" = the 3 soonest open slots of non-workshop sessions; workshop dates list under "Upcoming workshops" only while seats are left; (3) hero is a neutral placeholder until photos arrive (D29), with the scroll-edge fade held back until the hero scrolls away; (4) Book, "All times" and the slot chips stay disabled/inert until the Book screen (T14), and workshop rows open nothing until T13; (5) Share uses the system share sheet with a plain-text line (no web link exists yet); (6) the floating bar's inline title is hidden from screen readers so the name is announced once; (7) session-type lines: "Private 1:1 · 60 min · one person", "Small group · up to N, price per person", "Kids · ages A–B · up to N kids" (handoff's "one player" is sports-only wording)
nodes.rationale: Handoff §7.6 leaves these open
